question: Hello! Who are you and how can you help me?
answer: Hello! I am your AI FAQ Assistant. I can help answer questions regarding orders, shipping, returns, refunds, payment options, account settings, and discounts. What can I assist you with today?

question: Goodbye and thank you!
answer: You're very welcome! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask anytime. Have a wonderful day ahead!

question: How can I track my order status?
patterns: check delivery status of my package
answer: You can track your order in real-time by visiting the 'My Orders' section on your account dashboard or by clicking the tracking link provided in your shipment confirmation email.

question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
patterns: how do I cancel an order
can I change items in my order
answer: You can cancel or modify your order within 60 minutes of placing it directly from 'My Orders'. Once the order has entered the fulfillment/dispatch stage, it cannot be canceled, but you can easily initiate a return upon delivery.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
patterns: can I deliver to another location
answer: If your order has not been dispatched yet, you can update your shipping address in 'My Orders' -> 'Edit Details' or contact our support team immediately. Once dispatched, address changes depend on the courier partner.

question: What are your delivery times and shipping costs?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days and costs $4.99 (Free on all orders over $50). Express 1-2 day delivery is available for $9.99 at checkout.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
patterns: can you deliver outside the country
answer: Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide! International shipping takes 7 to 14 business days, and exact customs/import duties or shipping fees will be calculated at checkout based on your destination.

question: What should I do if my package is delayed or missing?
patterns: tracking shows delivered but not received
answer: If your package hasn't arrived within 2 days after the estimated delivery date, please verify the delivery location with neighbors or building reception. Then reach out to us with your Order ID, and we will open a courier investigation or issue a prompt replacement/refund.

question: What is your return policy?
patterns: how many days to return product
can I return an opened item
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy from the delivery date. Items must be in original condition, unused, with all tags and original packaging intact.

question: How do I initiate a return or exchange?
answer: To initiate a return, go to 'My Account' -> 'Returns & Replacements', select the item and reason, and download your prepaid return shipping label. Pack the item and drop it off at the designated courier drop point.

question: How long does it take to receive a refund?
patterns: when will I get my refund
how long for refund to hit bank account
answer: Once our warehouse inspects the returned item (usually within 2-3 business days), refunds are issued immediately. It typically reflects in your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days depending on your bank.

question: What payment methods are supported?
patterns: pay with credit card or PayPal
do you accept Apple Pay Google Pay
answer: We accept major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, UPI, and Buy Now Pay Later options like Klarna and Afterpay.

question: Is it safe to use my credit card on this website?
answer: Absolutely. All transactions are protected by end-to-end 256-bit SSL encryption and processed via PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment gateways. We never store your full card details or CVV.

question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
patterns: can I pay cash when package arrives
answer: Cash on Delivery (COD) is available in select pin codes and regions for orders below $200. You can check if COD is eligible at checkout after entering your postal code.

question: How do I reset my forgotten account password?
answer: Click on 'Sign In' at the top right, select 'Forgot Password?', enter your registered email address, and we'll send a secure password reset link to your inbox within minutes.

question: How do I change my registered email or phone number?
answer: Log into your account, navigate to 'Settings' -> 'Account Information', click 'Edit' next to your email or phone number, and verify the change with an OTP sent to your existing contact info.

question: How do I apply a discount code or coupon?
answer: During checkout on the payment review page, enter your promo code in the 'Gift Card or Promo Code' field and click 'Apply'. The discount will instantly be deducted from your total amount.

question: Why is my coupon code not working?
patterns: why does my discount not work
answer: Coupons may fail if they have expired, if the cart value hasn't met the minimum purchase amount, or if certain items in your cart are excluded from promotions. Also check for accidental typos or spaces.

question: How do I contact a human customer support agent?
answer: You can reach our human support team via Live Chat (available 24/7 on this website), by calling toll-free at +1 (800) 555-0199 (Mon-Sat 8am-8pm EST), or by emailing support@codealpha-faq.com.

question: What are your business and customer care operating hours?
answer: Our automated chat and online help center are available 24/7. Live phone agents and dedicated email support specialists are available Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST.
